Text fields support exact, negative, contains, and set operators. Timestamp fields support exact date, before, after, and set operators. A lifecycle timestamp filter includes that normally hidden state before applying its predicate, so `Ignored at is set` returns ignored accounts while an unfiltered list still hides them.
